name: Niambi
description: Niambi is Teferi and Subira's daughter, a Speaker and dream interpreter of Femeref who helps the Efravan refugees.

status.text: As of the latest story that mentions her, Niambi is alive with her family, with Teferi still trying to save her plane.

citations.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.
"The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Niambi return to the monument to attempt its puzzle again.
timeline.quote: Mark my words, this time I'll have the answer.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi opens the monument's entrance with his staff.
timeline.quote: A seam opened in the paving

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflexively blasts an automaton apart with a time spell.
timeline.quote: the time spell he reflexively cast blasted it so hard it separated into its component parts.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Niambi's mathematical theory fails after an hour of trying sequences.
timeline.quote: I was wrong, it's not a mathematical problem.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi says Urza had experimental subjects, not friends.
timeline.quote: Urza didn't have friends, not like you and I have friends.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight appears overhead, which Teferi calls his past catching up.
timeline.quote: It's my past, catching up with me.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana detects trapped spirits that factor into the puzzle.
timeline.quote: Aha, there are spirits here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
timeline.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
timeline.quote: This is what you were born to do.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Years later Subira settles down with Teferi and they raise Niambi.
timeline.quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
timeline.quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
timeline.quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
timeline.quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi examines Pallar, who asks why she risks the magistrate's displeasure by helping the Efravan, and Niambi tells her a dream of birds and a diseased tree.
timeline.quote: I saw a flock of birds searching for a home over a vast ocean.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi recalls protesting the decree against aiding the Efravan before the Council of Voices.
timeline.quote: Three days prior, Niambi held audience with him and the Council of Voices in the Great Chamber

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Awateh and the councilors claim the Efravan may be Phyrexian sleeper agents, and Teshunda sides with them.
timeline.quote: "There are Phyrexians out there, hiding in plain sight behind the wall!"

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teshunda has Niambi escorted out of the Great Chamber and refuses to help the Efravan.
timeline.quote: "Out!" Teshunda shouted, driving Niambi back on her heels.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Zar reports a tunnel to the abandoned mine is complete, and the Efravan plan to flee that night; Niambi insists on one more attempt with the magistrate.
timeline.quote: "When night falls and the first stars shine, we will move."

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi uses her glowing hands and a dream story to persuade guards to let her into the magistrate's estate.
timeline.quote: Touched by her words and the sun magic running through them, the guards allowed her through.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi learns the magistrate has not slept and finds him at the Great Chamber, where she asks about his dreams.
timeline.quote: to find the magistrate seated upon a fountain in the courtyard.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teshunda tells Niambi he dreamed the tree was himself and refused the little bird's help; she offers to take him to meet the bird.
timeline.quote: "To meet your bird."

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Niambi drives away with the magistrate in a carriage as Awateh, Gbega and Jabras try to stop them.
timeline.quote: "You'll kill us all!" screamed Awateh

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: At the mine, Pallar has given birth to Lark; Niambi reunites with her husband and daughter and brings Teshunda to see the Efravan.
timeline.quote: Pallar had had her child.

citation.text: "Faith in Birds" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
timeline.quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls freezing his daughter Niambi in time and then catching her, deciding to stand with Zhalfir rather than stop the fall.
timeline.quote: he had frozen her in time, arresting her mid-fall

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

relations.quote: I am the father of Niambi and husband of Subira.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
